shell/function/args/agree[none]_vs[gitga.notes: Shell functions do not have formal parameter lists in the signature (e.g., `func() { ... }`). Tree-sitter erroneously reports parameter lists in some edge cases. GitGalaxy correctly reports zero args.

shell/function/existence/agree[ctags,git.notes: GitGalaxy and Ctags are correct. Tree-sitter fails to recognize top-level functions like `check_limit_over()` in `moby/check-config.sh` due to a bug in its shell parser. GitGalaxy natively handles these correctly.

shell/function/existence/agree[ctags,tre.notes: GitGalaxy intentionally misses nested functions (like `zgrep` inside an `if` block in `moby/check-config.sh`) due to its architectural constraint of extracting only `scope_depth == 0` constructs via `_slice_by_keywords`. Other misses are due to unquoted keywords inside `echo` statements leaking scope (e.g., `for` inside `echo ... for $routine...` in `runulp.sh`) or SerenityOS Shell dialect differences (`if ... {` leaking scope because GitGalaxy expects POSIX `fi`). These are fundamental regex-parsing limitations of Mode D shell parsing.

shell/function/existence/agree[ctags]_vs.notes: Ctags incorrectly identifies shell variable assignments (e.g. `cmd=`, `FILTERED_ENV=`, `GREP_OPTS=`) as functions in some contexts. GitGalaxy and Tree-sitter correctly ignore them.
